# cli


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Installing fossick adds a `fossick` command. A shell script, or an agent
with only a terminal, can use the library through it. The command takes
a command name and then that command’s options:

``` sh
fossick search "sqlite wal mode" --n 5
fossick fetch https://example.com --auto
fossick read-arxiv 1706.03762 --source
fossick research "what is the raft consensus algorithm" --n 3
```

Most commands wrap the Python function of the same name. Their options
are that function’s arguments, with underscores written as hyphens:
`max_pages` becomes `--max-pages`. A command offers only some of the
function’s arguments. Output is readable markdown by default.
`--as-json` prints JSON instead, for piping into other programs.
`paginate-api` always prints JSON. `fossick <command> --help` lists a
command’s options. `fossick` alone lists the commands.

Two defaults differ from Python. `fossick search` reranks with BM25
(`--rerank lexical`), and
[`search`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/cli.html#search) in
Python keeps the merged order. `fossick search` uses `--region us-en`,
and [`search`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/cli.html#search) in
Python uses `region='auto'`.

### fetch

``` python
def fetch(
    url:str, # URL to fetch
    sel:str=None, # CSS selector to extract (None = full page)
    heavy:bool=False, # JS rendering via headless browser
    stealthy:bool=False, # Anti-bot stealth fetcher
    session:bool=False, # Route through the persistent debug Chrome (reuses its logged-in cookies)
    auto:bool=False, # Auto-escalate plain->heavy->stealthy->session on bot-block detection
    as_json:bool=False, # Output JSON instead of markdown
):
```

*Fetch a URL and print it as markdown.*

## The command table

`CMDS` maps each command name to its function.
[`main`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/cli.html#main) is the
entry point of the `fossick` script. It removes the command name from
the command line, parses the remaining options against that function’s
signature, and runs the function. An unknown command prints the list of
commands and exits with status 1. When you supply no command,
[`main`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/cli.html#main) prints the
command list and exits with status 0.

## Tests

The first cell checks that every command is registered and that the
options agents rely on exist. The second runs
[`research`](https://vedicreader.github.io/fossick/cli.html#research)
against live services and is skipped by the tests.

``` python
# end-to-end: the research CLI runs against live services and prints a cited corpus
import io
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
buf = io.StringIO()
with redirect_stdout(buf): research.__wrapped__('what is the raft consensus algorithm', n=2)
out = buf.getvalue()
assert out.startswith('# Research:') and 'http' in out
print(out[:300])
```

``` python
from pathlib import Path
```

``` python
# The CLI's `search`, `fetch`, `crawl` and `research` share names with the library's, and nbdev's doc links resolve a
# bare name to the CLI page first, so index.ipynb links them by hand; the README must not send readers to cli.html.
assert 'cli.html#' not in Path('../README.md').read_text()
```
